entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I ordered something and it's not right. I'm a bit confused about what to do.
I can definitely help with that. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
My name is Alex Chen. The order number is... uh... VF-8675309. I think. The website was so complicated.

Thank you, Alex. I see your order for the Apex Performance Jersey right here. It looks like it was delivered just three days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A preference? I guess? It's the jersey. I just tried it on and it's the wrong size. It feels way too tight across the shoulders. I don't know what to do next. The return page has all these options... can't you just help me?

Of course, Alex. I'm happy to walk you through it. Since the jersey is simply the wrong size and you received it recently, you're well within our 90-day return window. We can easily set up an exchange for a different size. Would you like to do that?
Oh, really? An exchange? That would be great. I was so worried I was stuck with it because it was too tight.

Not at all. I've just initiated the exchange process for you in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label. Just package the jersey back up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we see it's on its way back, we'll ship out the new size for you. What size would you like instead?
A Large, please. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome, Alex. I've updated the order to a size Large. The confirmation email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
